title: Install record
description: What the install changed about the repository that is not a file, so uninstall can put it back. Written once at setup and when sync-settings first applies protection. Doc 09.

branch_protection_existed.description: Whether the default branch already had protection before the factory arrived. If it did not, uninstall may remove protection entirely; if it did, it only removes the checks the factory added.

added_checks.description: Required checks the factory added, so uninstall removes exactly those and leaves anything a person added alone.
